label: SDK: Dump Request (Python)
description: Print action/args/paths/system + a small config preview (Python)

template.source:
from lyenv_sdk import read_request, log, respond_ok, action, args, paths, system, config_plugin, config_global

req = read_request()
log(f"action={action()}")
log(f"args={args()}")
log(f"paths={paths()}")
log(f"system={system()}")
log(f"plugin.driver.name={config_plugin('driver.name','')} ")
log(f"global.env.name={config_global('env.name','')} ")
respond_ok('')

label: SDK: Read Config (Python)
description: Read plugin/global config by dotted key (Python). Quick test via CLI args: scope key default -> value

template.source:
from lyenv_sdk import read_request, respond_ok, config_get

req = read_request()
# Quick test via CLI args:
#   arg0=scope (plugin/global)
#   arg1=key
#   arg2=default(optional)

scope = (req.get('args') or ['plugin'])[0]
key = (req.get('args') or ['plugin',''])[1] if len(req.get('args') or [])>1 else ''
defv = (req.get('args') or ['','',''])[2] if len(req.get('args') or [])>2 else ''

val = config_get(key, defv, scope=scope)
respond_ok(str(val) if val is not None else '')

label: SDK: Mutate Plugin Config (Python)
description: Write plugin mutation by dotted key (Python). Quick test via CLI args: key value

template.source:
from lyenv_sdk import read_request, respond_ok, mutate, log

req = read_request()
args = req.get('args') or []
key = args[0] if len(args)>0 else 'demo.hello.enabled'
val = args[1] if len(args)>1 else 'true'

mutate(key, val, scope='plugin')
log(f"mutate plugin: {key}={val}")
respond_ok('')

label: SDK: Mutate Global Config (Python)
description: Write global mutation by dotted key (Python). Writes demo.last_run_at in UTC

template.source:
import time
from lyenv_sdk import read_request, respond_ok, mutate, log

req = read_request()
key = 'demo.last_run_at'
val = time.strftime('%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ', time.gmtime())

mutate(key, val, scope='global')
log(f"mutate global: {key}={val}")
respond_ok('')

label: SDK: Emit Artifact (Python)
description: Append an artifact path into response.artifacts (Python)

template.source:
from lyenv_sdk import read_request, respond_ok, emit_artifact, get_path, log

req = read_request()
ws = get_path('workspace','')
out = (ws + '/out/demo.txt') if ws else 'out/demo.txt'
emit_artifact(out)
log(f"artifact={out}")
respond_ok('')
